finding.comment: the consumer processes each line as the object it is, selecting on .patch directly — per-object streaming that matches the documented JSONL format

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/collect.sh
+++ b/scripts/collect.sh
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 # changed files were gathered as JSONL (one object per line):
 #   jq -c '.[]' <<<"$batch" >>"$files_jsonl"
+jq -c 'select(.patch != null)' <"$files_jsonl" >/dev/null
+echo "textual changes present"
